metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 22% a year over 5 years, 18% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months 26%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 51% a year over 5 years, 23% over 3; last 12 months 38%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 18% of net profit (weak).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹136,936 cr, 1.47× equity; up from ₹77,605 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Management beat the FY26 ROE target by delivering an actual ROE of 20% versus the targeted 18%.
EPS growth significantly outperformed expectations, reaching 34% compared to the multi-year target of 15% to 20%.
Operating margins expanded from 16% in FY22 to 19% by FY26, showcasing strong profitability gains.

bear.point: Auto revenue growth missed guidance with SUV growth reaching only 14.9% compared to mid-to-high teens targets.
Cash conversion was exceptionally weak over five years, with operating cash flow making up only 18% of net profit.
Borrowings surged significantly to 1.47 times equity, totaling 136,936 crores and increasing financial leverage.
